versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the raindance-video-storyboard-director skill.
- Plan original visual story briefs and timed 11-beat storyboards inspired by the Raindance social-video trend, using only user-provided details.
- Includes a rights and consent check before generating ready-to-use briefs.
- Text-only workflow: does not generate, inspect, or submit video or photos.
- Optional integration with a read-only MCP for deterministic text planning helpers.
- Provides detailed workflow steps and links to official resources, guides, and product site.
